onboarding.title: Welcome to Waqaya
onboarding.description: Practice infection-control decisions in realistic hospital situations. Every choice is checked against protocol steps based on WHO and CDC guidance, and your result shows exactly what to review.
onboarding.step1: A blood spill, a used needle, a hand-hygiene station and more.
onboarding.step2: Each choice maps to a step of the protocol.
onboarding.step3: Your score, every mistake explained, and what to practice next.

onboarding.title: Start measuring compliance
onboarding.description: Results, trends and gaps appear here after the first finalized scan or completed simulation.
onboarding.invite: Add examiners who run scans and trainees who train.
onboarding.scan: Photograph an area such as a sink or a sharps container. The AI checks each visible step, and the examiner reviews and finalizes the result.
onboarding.train: Trainees complete realistic scenarios; their scores and weak steps appear here and in the reports.
